newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Summers says U.S. economy very healthy.
newsitem.headline: Summers says U.S. economy very healthy.

text.p: U.S. Deputy Treasury Lawrence Summers said on Friday the U.S. economy was in a very healthy state and the current expansion had a long way to run.

"While there is much to be concerned about, I'm able to take some satisfaction from the fact that our economy is in a very healthy situation, in many ways, a more healthy situation than it has been in at any time in my professional lifetime," Summers told a news conference in Singapore.

He said the current combination of high investments, low inflation, a declining budget deficit and a healthy financial system suggested the U.S. economic expansion could have "a very long way to run".
As the economy approached full employment, he said, "the prospects that the expansion will start to deliver rising real wages in a more clear cut way become much more aggressive."
